Class CardToken

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.shared.model.CardToken
public final class CardToken extends Object
String constants used to compose the typeLabel and effectsLabel fields of CardDTO. The client TUI/GUI renders these tokens as icons or formatted text. Using constants here instead of raw strings keeps the server model and client rendering in sync.
